354:t_009:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「That pink EVA over there is...」

354:t_009:21.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Four-Eyes! Stop wasting time being friendly!」

354:t_009:22.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We can talk later, $$アスカ$$! Bring $$シンジ$$, $$レイ#pt394$$, and $$マリ$$ over and join us!」

354:t_009:23.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Unit-02 and Unit-08 will follow your orders. But I don't know about those other two...」

354:t_009:25.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Even in this situation, she doesn't seem able to let go of herself...」

354:t_009:27.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$カヲル$$... What... should we do...?」

354:t_009:28.en:
$$カヲル$$
「What do you want to do?」

354:t_009:30.en:
$n
「Stop dawdling, $$シンジ$$! They're targeting the EVAs!」

354:t_009:31.en:
$$アルト$$
「Come over to us! You're still part of $c!」

354:t_009:33.en:
$$カヲル$$
(People who accept you... $$シンジ$$... This is where you belong...)

354:t_010:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Understood. I'll dispose of those artificial humans and $c.」

354:t_011:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$...」

354:t_013:0.en:
$$メール$$
「$$ストラウス$$'s leaving, Darling!」

354:t_013:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It seems their $$欲深な金牛$$ $$スフィア$$ and your $$傷だらけの獅子$$ are compatible.」

354:t_013:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Apparently, compatible $$スフィア$$s resonate and strengthen each other's power.」

354:t_013:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「So that unease I felt from $$ストラウス$$ was caused by their $$スフィア$$ and mine...」

354:t_014:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「$$ストラウス$$ has pulled back. Once we finish the remaining forces, we win.」

354:t_014:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Are you ready, $$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$?!」

354:t_014:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't speak to me so casually...」

354:t_014:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「We're only joining forces for now... Don't get the wrong idea.」

354:t_014:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$. There are still things we have to do.」

354:t_014:11.en:
$$カヲル$$
「Let's get through this to keep hope alive, alongside the people who care about you.」

354:t_015:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I've confirmed all enemies have been destroyed!」

354:t_015:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Don't let your guard down! Something else is still coming!」

354:t_017:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「It appears to be the Empire's troops who remained aboard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

354:t_018:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That's a relief... They didn't blow up the place when they escaped.」

354:t_018:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「They probably understood how valuable $$ヴェーダ$$ is, too.」

354:t_018:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But we don't know what traps they may have set.」

354:t_018:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, enter the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ cautiously, then inspect each block.」

354:t_018:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ティエリア$$, please access $$ヴェーダ$$ and check its systems.」

354:t_018:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...In the meantime, we'd like to talk among ourselves for a while.」

354:t_018:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「That's fine. I'm sure you want to assess the situation and consider your next steps.」

354:t_018:8.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You can use the $$トレミー$$'s briefing room. Feel free to view any data you need.」

354:t_018:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「It looks like you've learned some manners while you were away.」

354:t_018:12.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well... A girl can't keep dreaming forever, y'know.」

354:t_018:13.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Keep your comments to yourself, Four-Eyes.」

354:t_018:15.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Let's go, Brat $$シンジ$$. We'll decide where we stand with you there.」

354:t_019:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「M-my mistake...! To fall behind them in front of Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$...!」

354:t_019:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Oh, thank you for those gracious words! I, $$ダバラーン・タウ$$... will take them to heart and swear to avenge this defeat!」

354:t_019:3.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then, I take my leave!」

354:t_020:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「He must be utterly devoted to that $$ストラウス$$.」

354:t_021:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「M-my mistake...! To fall behind them on a battlefield Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ entrusted to me...!」

354:t_021:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「What a disgrace...! I can only beg Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$'s forgiveness and swear to avenge this defeat!」

354:t_022:1.en:
$$隼人$$
「He must be utterly devoted to that $$ストラウス$$.」

354:t_023:0.en:
$$カヲル$$
(People striving to live, even while fate tosses them about...)

354:t_023:1.en:
$$カヲル$$
(I'm happy. I'm sure you'll find happiness someday...)

354:t_100:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Retaking $$ヴェーダ$$ is the first step in our counterattack...!」

354:t_100:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$...! I'm breaking through the enemy interception force!」

354:t_101:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
(The data in $$ヴェーダ$$'s deepest reaches... $$イオリア・シュヘンベルグ$$'s true intentions...)
